mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) during supply chain disruption phases intensifies input cost pressures, reducing corporate margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed monetary easing and higher real rates, which depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Real consumer spending (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates sustained demand strength, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 12-month MA, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment below 4.0% combined with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k in the prior month signals intense wage pressures, accelerating inflation expectations and triggering monetary tightening, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage pressures
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 100k, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates supply shock amplified by monetary tightening, increasing equity volatility and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3 years.
